عَبْعَابٌ A tall man; (S, O, K;) as also ↓ عَبْعَبٌ . (O, K.) ―
-b2- And A man having an ample throat and chest. (O, K.) One says رَجُلٌ عَبْعَابٌ قَبْقَابٌ A man having an ample throat and chest, big (جَلِيل) in speech. (O.) ―
-b3- And A youth, or or young man, (TA,) or an ass, (O, [in which this application is confirmed by the citation of a verse wherein the epithet is evidently applied to a swift beast such as the wild ass,]) full-grown, and goodly in make. (O, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
